findings.title: Constrain the actual startup command and preserve namespace ownership
findings.description: readiness_content_errors checks only whether four endpoint substrings occur anywhere in start(), rejects a few direct method names, then replaces the entire proposed start() AST with the base method before the final comparison. Consequently the new KL-074 scope gate accepts changes outside the ratified readiness boundary. Against the committed protected-base lifecycle, I added the allowed explicit TCP arguments and then inserted self.namespace = DatabaseNamespace(project_name="shared", database_name="postgres") before self.validate_compose() in start(): the guard returned []. Unchanged reset() subsequently uses this overwritten namespace for its DROP/CREATE target and Compose project. Independently, changing the actual startup probe's host to "shared" while adding an unused endpoint_note = "127.0.0.1" also returned []. These are concrete violations of the packet's owned-namespace and exact-loopback boundaries, not PostgreSQL test failures. All 29 committed scope regressions pass and do not cover these bypasses.
findings.requested_change: Constrain permitted start() changes structurally to the actual readiness command and bounded deadline/probe plumbing. Preserve command/project/namespace/credential ownership and normal startup handling, and validate host/port on the executed pg_isready call rather than as arbitrary method substrings. Add negative regressions proving namespace/credential mutations, foreign endpoint substitution with unused expected literals, and direct command-based SQL bypasses fail closed, alongside a positive bounded-readiness candidate. Commit a new tested governance revision with updated bound evidence, then obtain fresh reviews.

observations: Direct Git diff inspection and an independent local read-only audit found exactly 48 changed files, matching HG-037 files_changed. Backlog and traceability append precisely one previously unused harness-backlog-v0.2/KL-074 task; every prior task object is identical to protected base 822322dfcac69d1042c8f9f7517cecf4903f8163.

KL-074 begins NOT_STARTED, has empty requirement/evidence claims, nine check contracts, a complete matching packet and traceability projection, and no task result/review/integration artifacts. Dependencies retain merged KL-002, KL-013 and KL-023 as historical inputs. Product sources, Compose, DB/unit tests, migrations, CI workflows, completed results, integrations, frozen authorities, requirement authorities and prior evidence are unchanged in the reviewed diff.

base 822322dfcac69d1042c8f9f7517cecf4903f8163 is an ancestor of tested implementation 87ff1dc6235140d1481003da79107296d720870a, which is the direct parent of reviewed governance/evidence head 4b1533bc6bf2052d859e2b079116e0d408013f43. The validator's tested-to-reviewed governance suffix check returned no errors; all eight committed check logs contain the exact tested SHA and successful exit status.

Committed governance evidence reports 29 readiness-scope, 404 harness and 207 unit tests passing, plus harness validation, lint, typecheck and clean diff. Independently reran tests/harness/test_readiness_scope.py with the existing Python environment, PYTHONPATH=src, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and no pytest cache: 29 passed. Independently exercised the committed guard with in-memory candidate blobs; both ownership/endpoint bypasses returned no errors. No PostgreSQL or Docker operations were performed.

Readiness evidence honestly distinguishes the saved mutable upstream entrypoint reference and same-head hosted setup failures/success from unverified deployed-image root cause. Future actual-image coldstart, migration, isolation, cleanup and full-suite checks remain NOT_RUN; governance PASS does not claim task/product/release PASS or activation.

The only changed task definition requires GENERAL and DB_CONCURRENCY, so their union is the required governance review set. This GENERAL review is CHANGES_REQUIRED and cannot satisfy the merge gate; no merge recommendation is made.
